verification_report.summary: Both supplied proofs are correct under the stated compact Kähler, closed Bott–Chern hypotheses and accepted inputs. Choosing eta before epsilon and epsilon before Gamma is valid. Closedness makes c_epsilon and N_epsilon positive and independent of Gamma. The smooth positive H has mean N_epsilon; the inverse-eigenvalue identity gives exactly the factor 1/k, and Cauchy–Schwarz yields integral(a_epsilon wedge Gamma) >= c_epsilon/(k N_epsilon) > 1. Lamari therefore applies to the fixed class A-B', and adding eta omega_Z proves bigness without a limiting argument. The attribution and estimate match [Popovici, Theorem 1.1 and Lemma 3.2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1405.2518v2). In the domination proof, C_* is finite, strictly positive, and independent of eta and v. The choice 2k delta_* C_* < h0 yields the required numerical gap on every sufficiently late Kähler resolution, justifying replacement of 8k by 2k. The curve case, zero mixed intersections, cohomological cancellations, descent, ideal-preorder direction, and fixed-model divisorial limit all pass. The rescaling delta0=delta_*/4 is consistent. No critical errors or gaps were found within this bounded verification.
